meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果AI助手经常因上下文丢失而中断工作
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans with files to survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI agent often loses work due to context clearing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在磁盘上维护 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 三个文件，作为持久化工作记忆。每次对话开始或工具调用前后，它会自动读取这些文件来恢复任务状态，并在执行操作后更新进度。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。也支持在 /clear 后自动恢复会话。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建任务计划文件并开始跟踪进度。

say.text: 记录刚才的研究发现到 findings.md。
更新 progress.md，标记当前阶段完成。
say.note: Claude 会更新进度文件并标记阶段状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude maintains three files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) on disk as persistent working memory. It automatically reads these files at the start of each conversation and after tool calls to restore task state, and updates progress after actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Also supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-step project and create task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude creates a task plan file and starts tracking progress.

say_en.text: Log the research findings to findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude writes current findings to findings.md.

say_en.text: Update progress.md and mark the current phase complete.
say_en.note: Claude updates the progress file and marks phase status.
